answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on boundary conditions tested before the happy path. A lagoon of per-task receipts records who did what, and the whisper of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a checklist tone, short verdict at the end register, it stays short. Reaching the trellis of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
